title: NE (New Executable) signature (Windows 1.x/2.x)
summary: NE (New Executable) is the 16-bit Windows executable format. Magic: 'MZ' at offset 0, with 'NE' at the offset specified by e_lfanew (offset 0x3C). Used by Windows 1.0-3.x and OS/2 1.x.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: NE is the 16-bit predecessor of PE (32-bit).
NE supports multiple segments, resources, and dynamic linking.
NE is used by Windows 1.0-3.x, Windows 95 (16-bit apps), and OS/2 1.x.
